# Products

Manage products in Teamleader Focus.

```php
Teamleader::products()
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Class | `McoreServices\TeamleaderSDK\Resources\Products\Products` |
| Create / update / delete | ✓ / ✓ / ✓ |
| Pagination | `page_size` / `page_number`; no totals — a short page is the last one. Every page: [`lazy()` / `cursor()`](../../guides/pagination.md#fetching-everything) |

## Endpoints

- `products.add`
- `products.delete`
- `products.info`
- `products.list`
- `products.update`

## Filters

Passed as the first argument to `list()`. Any other key throws.

| Filter | Description |
|---|---|
| `ids` | Array of product UUIDs |
| `term` | Search term (will filter on the name or the code) |
| `updated_since` | ISO 8601 datetime |

## Includes

| Endpoint | Includes |
|---|---|
| `list()` | none |
| `info()` | `suppliers` |

## Accepted values

Public constants on the class. Body fields and enum values outside these lists
throw before the request is sent.

| Constant | Values |
|---|---|
| `ADD_FIELDS` | `name`, `code`, `description`, `purchase_price`, `selling_price`, `unit_of_measure_id`, `price_list_prices`, `stock`, `configuration`, `department_id`, `product_category_id`, `tax_rate_id`, `custom_fields` |
| `CURRENCIES` | `BAM`, `CAD`, `CHF`, `CLP`, `CNY`, `COP`, `CZK`, `DKK`, `EUR`, `GBP`, `INR`, `ISK`, `JPY`, `MAD`, `MXN`, `NOK`, `PEN`, `PLN`, `RON`, `SEK`, `TRY`, `USD`, `ZAR` |
| `INFO_INCLUDES` | `suppliers` |
| `STOCK_THRESHOLD_ACTIONS` | `notify` |
| `UPDATE_FIELDS` | `name`, `code`, `description`, `purchase_price`, `selling_price`, `unit_of_measure_id`, `price_list_prices`, `stock`, `configuration`, `department_id`, `product_category_id`, `tax_rate_id`, `custom_fields` |

## Methods

### `list()`

```php
list(array $filters = [], array $options = []): array
```

List products

- `$filters` — ids, term (name or code), updated_since
- `$options` — page_size, page_number

**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException` On an unknown filter key or option

### `info()`

```php
info($id, $includes = null): array
```

Get one product

Custom fields are part of every info response; `suppliers` is the only
include.

- `$id` — Product UUID
- `$includes` — suppliers

**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException` On an include products.info does not accept

### `create()`

```php
create(array $data): array
```

Create a product

Requires a name or a code.

**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException` When neither is given, or a field or value is not accepted

### `update()`

```php
update($id, array $data): array
```

Update a product

Every field is optional; name, code, description, prices,
unit_of_measure_id and configuration take null to clear them.

**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException` When a field or value is not accepted

### `delete()`

```php
delete($id, ...$additionalParams): array
```

### `search()`

```php
search(string $term, array $options = []): array
```

Search products by name or code

### `updatedSince()`

```php
updatedSince(string $date, array $options = []): array
```

Get products updated since a datetime

- `$date` — ISO 8601 datetime

### `withSuppliers()`

```php
withSuppliers(): self
```

## Examples

Get all products:

```php
$products = Teamleader::products()->list();
```

Search products by name or code:

```php
$products = Teamleader::products()->search("cookies");
```

Get a product with its suppliers:

```php
$product = Teamleader::products()->withSuppliers()->info("product-uuid");
```

Create a new product:

```php
$product = Teamleader::products()->create(["name" => "Dark Chocolate Cookies", "code" => "COOK-DARK-001"]);
```

Set a price on a price list:

```php
Teamleader::products()->update("product-uuid", [
    "price_list_prices" => [
        ["price_list_id" => "price-list-uuid", "price" => ["amount" => 9.95, "currency" => "EUR"]],
    ],
]);
```
